topic: Top CO2 emitting countries from 1990 to 2024, annual emissions data

interpretations.label: Total Territorial CO2 Emissions
interpretations.description: Annual carbon dioxide emissions produced within a country's national borders from fossil fuel combustion and industrial processes.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Million metric tons of CO2 per year (Mt CO2/yr)
caveats: Excludes land-use change and forestry emissions
Does not account for embedded carbon in international trade

interpretations.label: Consumption-Based CO2 Emissions
interpretations.description: Annual carbon dioxide emissions allocated to the final consumer country after adjusting for imports and exports of goods and services.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Million metric tons of CO2 per year (Mt CO2/yr)
caveats: Subject to greater estimation uncertainty and reporting lags
Relies on global economic input-output models

interpretations.label: Per Capita CO2 Emissions
interpretations.description: Total annual territorial carbon dioxide emissions divided by the national population for the given year.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Metric tons of CO2 per person per year (t CO2/person/yr)
caveats: Does not reflect total absolute contribution to global atmospheric concentration
Can skew high for smaller energy-exporting economies

preferredSources: International Energy Agency (IEA) CO2 Emissions from Fuel Combustion
EDGAR (Emissions Database for Global Atmospheric Research)
knownRisks: Preliminary data limitations and reporting lags for the years 2023 and 2024
Retroactive historical revisions by reporting agencies due to methodology updates
Accounting differences regarding international bunker fuels
